\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tikz}
\newsavebox{\sample}
\newdimen\cornerX
\newdimen\cornerY
% Reading anchors does not draw a path or change the picture's bounds.
\newcommand{\probe}[4][]{%
  \sbox{\sample}{\begin{tikzpicture}[#1]
    \node[minimum width=60pt,minimum height=30pt,inner sep=0pt,#3] (R) {#4};
    % Measure the saved node in canvas coordinates, outside the picture CTM.
    \pgftransformreset
    \pgfextractx{\cornerX}{\pgfpointanchor{R}{north east}}
    \pgfextracty{\cornerY}{\pgfpointanchor{R}{north east}}
    \typeout{CORNER #2 \the\cornerX\space\the\cornerY}
  \end{tikzpicture}}%
  \typeout{PAGE #2 \the\wd\sample\space\the\dimexpr\ht\sample+\dp\sample\relax}}
\begin{document}
\probe{stroke}{draw,line width=4pt}{Box}
\probe{tight}{draw,line width=4pt,outer sep=0pt}{Box}
\probe{outside}{draw,line width=4pt,outer xsep=10pt,outer ysep=6pt}{Box}
\probe{fill}{fill=red,line width=4pt,outer sep=10pt}{Box}
\probe{round}{draw,rounded corners=3pt,line width=4pt}{Box}
\probe{oversized}{draw,rounded corners=24pt,line width=4pt}{Box}
\probe{negative}{draw,rounded corners=-3pt,line width=4pt}{Box}
\probe{unitless}{draw,rounded corners=5,line width=4pt}{Box}
\probe{rotate}{draw,line width=4pt,rotate=30}{Box}
\probe{empty}{draw,line width=4pt,rotate=30}{}
\probe{roundrot}{draw,rounded corners=3pt,line width=4pt,rotate=30}{Box}
\probe[scale=1.5,transform shape]{scaled}{draw,line width=4pt}{Box}
\probe[scale=1.5,transform shape]{scaledround}{draw,rounded corners=4pt,line width=4pt}{Box}
\probe[scale=1.5,transform shape]{scaleddouble}{draw,double=blue,double distance=3pt,line width=2pt}{Box}
\probe{double}{draw,double,line width=2pt}{Box}
\probe{color}{draw=red,double=blue,double distance=3pt,line width=2pt}{Box}
\probe{center}{draw,double distance between line centers=6pt,line width=2pt}{Box}
\probe{single}{draw,double distance=6pt,double=none,line width=2pt}{Box}
\probe{reenable}{draw,double=none,double distance=3pt,line width=2pt}{Box}
\probe{zerogap}{draw=red,double distance=0pt,line width=2pt}{Box}
\probe{overlap}{draw=red,double distance between line centers=1pt,line width=4pt}{Box}
\probe{rememberink}{draw=red,double=blue,double,double=none,double distance=3pt,line width=2pt}{Box}
\probe{noframedraw}{fill=red,double,line width=4pt}{Box}
\end{document}
